$schema: Hook registry for Phantom. Consumed by hook-router.js.

hooks.name: feature-branch-gate
hooks.description: Blocks edits on default/protected branches (configurable via git.protected_branches / PHANTOM_PROTECTED_BRANCHES)

hooks.name: fix-loop-gate
hooks.description: Surfaces the fix-loop ceiling at the phantom:fix Skill boundary (advisory only; never denies)

hooks.name: pre-phase-context
hooks.description: Injects reference content for current session phase

hooks.name: validate-artifact
hooks.description: Validates _meta headers in session artifact JSON

hooks.name: observation-capture
hooks.description: Captures structural file observations to NDJSON

hooks.name: memory-consolidator
hooks.description: Distills session state to memory-snapshot.json before compaction

hooks.name: context-compact-guide
hooks.description: Outputs compact guidance before context compaction

hooks.name: memory-reader
hooks.description: Injects relevant learnings from INDEX.md before each prompt

hooks.name: memory-writer
hooks.description: Extracts learning candidates from this turn's observations

hooks.name: router-nudge
hooks.description: One-shot advisory nudge toward phantom:start when a prompt matches implementation triggers and no phantom session is active (never blocks)

hooks.name: routing-gate
hooks.description: Opt-in discipline gate (routing.enforce: true): denies edits in phantom-known repos outside a phantom session; fails OPEN; PHANTOM_ADHOC=1 bypasses with logging
